question: Should OpenClaw accept `includeFamily` as the bounded model-facing contract for retrieving reset-family archived transcript history through `chat.history` and `sessions_history`?
rationale: This changes the session-history visibility boundary and public protocol/tool surface, which requires maintainer intent even though the patch has tests and no concrete code-review finding.

options.title: Accept bounded includeFamily
options.body: Approve `includeFamily` as the opt-in selector, keep the offset rejection and archive ownership checks, and land after exact-head gates refresh.

options.title: Narrow before merge
options.body: Ask the author to rename, hide, or further restrict the selector before it becomes a public model-facing contract.

options.title: Pause for different surface
options.body: Pause or close this PR if maintainers want archived-history recovery exposed only through a UI/export/diagnostic surface rather than the model-facing history tool.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded includeFamily
recommendation.body: Approve `includeFamily` as the opt-in selector, keep the offset rejection and archive ownership checks, and land after exact-head gates refresh.

likelyOwner.reason: Most recent merged owner of the same `sessions_history`/`chat.history` pagination API surface.
